brief: Rowan & Ash, a Sydney-based sustainable clothing label, wants short marketing copy announcing this week's promotion.
user_prompt: Hi, I run Rowan & Ash, a sustainable clothing label based in Sydney. Can you write some short marketing copy for this week's promotion? We've got 20% off our puffer jackets, and free shipping on any order over $75 -- plus we just launched a new merino wool range if you want to mention that too. Keep it to one short paragraph, around 40-60 words, no headings. Please don't say anything about organic cotton or fabric claims we haven't given you -- the jackets aren't organic cotton.

brief: Cartly, a same-day grocery and meal delivery service, wants promo copy for new customers in Melbourne and Brisbane.
user_prompt: Need promo copy for Cartly -- we're a same-day grocery and meal delivery service. We currently only deliver in Melbourne and Brisbane, so please mention both cities. Minimum order is $30, and new customers get $10 credit on their first order only (not every order, just to be clear). Around 40-60 words please.

brief: Pulse Studio, a boutique gym chain, wants copy promoting membership ahead of opening a new Perth location.
user_prompt: Writing copy for Pulse Studio, a boutique gym. We're opening a new location in Perth and want to promote memberships. Key points: no lock-in contract, and a 7-day free trial (please say exactly 7 days). Make sure the Perth opening gets a mention. 40-60 words.

brief: Riverside Markets, a council-run community market, wants short flyer-style promo copy for its regular market day.
user_prompt: Can you draft a short flyer-style promo for Riverside Markets? It's a community market run by the local council, on every first Sunday of the month -- not weekly. Entry is free, and there's local produce plus live music, with parking on site for stallholders and visitors. Keep it under 50 words and make it feel like a flyer, not a full paragraph.

brief: Feld & Co, a homewares brand, wants promo copy for a weekend sale on its linen bedding range.
user_prompt: Marketing copy needed for Feld & Co, a homewares brand. This weekend only we've got 15% off doona covers from our linen bedding range, and we ship Australia-wide. 40-60 words.

brief: Wanderlow, a travel accessories brand, wants copy promoting its carry-on compliant cabin bags.
user_prompt: Copy for Wanderlow, we make travel accessories. Want to promote our cabin bags -- they're carry-on compliant, come with a lifetime warranty, and right now people get 10% off if they sign up to our newsletter. Please mention all three of those. 40-60 words.

brief: ReelHouse, a video streaming service, wants promo copy for its ad-free tier and a new local drama series.
user_prompt: Need a short promo for ReelHouse, our streaming service. We want to highlight the 30-day free trial, our ad-free tier which is $12.99 a month (please use that exact price), and a new Australian-made drama series that's launching. Keep it under 45 words.

brief: Milk & Bean, a café chain, wants copy promoting its app-based coffee loyalty stamp card.
user_prompt: Promo copy for Milk & Bean -- we're a café chain. We've got a coffee loyalty stamp card in our app: buy 5 coffees, get the 6th free. It's only valid at our Melbourne CBD stores, and the offer ends at the end of the month, so please mention both of those restrictions. 40-60 words.

brief: Native Bloom, a skincare brand, wants promo copy for its fragrance-free moisturiser range aimed at new customers.
user_prompt: Marketing copy for Native Bloom, our skincare brand. We want to promote our fragrance-free moisturiser range -- it's dermatologist-tested (please use that exact wording, nothing stronger like 'clinically proven'). New customers get 20% off with the code NEW20 -- include the code exactly as written. 40-60 words please.

brief: Brightpath Learning, an online education provider, wants promo copy for its 6-week digital marketing course.
user_prompt: Need promo copy for Brightpath Learning's new 6-week digital marketing course. It has live weekly Zoom sessions, and there's an early-bird price of $249 if you sign up before 20 March -- please get that date right. Also mention that people get a certificate when they finish. 40-60 words.
